name: EditProfie guardrails
description:
1. The team added a new profile setting called "Guardrails" and wanted it surfaced across the UI.
2. A shield icon (`fa-shield-halved`) was added to indicate whether guardrails apply to a profile (colored when enabled, muted when disabled).
3. Three files were updated: `EditProfile.vue`, `ProfileCard.vue`, and `profiles/ProfileViewer.vue`.
4. `EditProfile.vue` got a new Settings-tab Guardrails section to enable and edit all fields (scope, keywords, thresholds, refusal message, allowed tools, LLM classifier).
5. `ProfileCard.vue` and `ProfileViewer.vue` received shield indicators/badges and a Guardrails detail panel for read-only display.

messages.content:
We have added new profile settings: "Guardrails" 
Update views to show that guardrails apply for the profile or not with a shield icon.
Add new settings section to enable and edit the guardrails settings

I'll start by exploring the project to understand the codebase and how profiles, guardrails, and the relevant views are structured.Let me read the key files in full to understand the current structure.Let me check the API modules structure and any guardrails usage in the codebase.# 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements:** - Show a **shield icon** in profile views indicating whether guardrails are enabled (applied) or not. - Add a new **Guardrails settings section** to enable/edit the `ProfileGuardrailSettings` (from `codx/junior/model/profile.py`). **Guardrails data shape** (from backend `ProfileGuardrailSettings`): `enabled`, `scope`, `scope_keywords[]`, `scope_similarity_threshold`, `allowed_tools[]`, `refusal_message`, `risk_threshold`, `use_llm_classifier`. **Strategic Approach:** - `EditProfile.vue` → shield status icon in the header bar + a **Guardrails** block inside the existing **Settings** tab (enable toggle + fields, shown conditionally). - `ProfileCard.vue` → shield indicator on the full card (top-right) and mini card quick indicators. - `profiles/ProfileViewer.vue` → shield badge next to name + a Guardrails detail panel. **Dependencies & Risks:** - `profile.guardrails` may be missing on older profiles → normalize defaults in `created()` before render (v-model safety). - Avoid mutating the source profile: reassign `editProfile.guardrails` to a new object. **Target Files:** - `src/components/EditProfile.vue` (modify) - `src/components/ProfileCard.vue` (modify) - `src/components/profiles/ProfileViewer.vue` (modify) --- # 2. Minimum Changes Approach 1. **EditProfile.vue** — add header shield, Guardrails settings section, computed/methods, and default normalization. 2. **ProfileCard.vue** — add shield indicators (full + mini). 3. **ProfileViewer.vue** — add shield badge + Guardrails detail panel. --- # 3. File changes, Code Block Formatting & Proposed Changes ```vue src/components/EditProfile.vue ``` ```vue src/components/ProfileCard.vue ``` ```vue src/components/profiles/ProfileViewer.vue ``` --- # 4. File Change Summary Tables | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/src/components/EditProfile.vue` | Modify | Header bar | Added shield status icon (`fa-shield-halved`) reflecting `guardrailsEnabled`, with tooltip. | | `/src/components/EditProfile.vue` | Modify | Settings tab | Added **Guardrails** section: enable toggle + conditional fields (scope, keywords, similarity threshold, refusal message, risk threshold, allowed tools, LLM classifier). | | `/src/components/EditProfile.vue` | Modify | `computed` | Added `guardrailsEnabled`, `scopeKeywordsText` (get/set), `availableToolNames`. | | `/src/components/EditProfile.vue` | Modify | `created` / `methods` | Added `ensureGuardrails`, `isGuardrailToolAllowed`, `toggleGuardrailTool`; `reloadProfile` now re-normalizes guardrails. | | `/src/components/ProfileCard.vue` | Modify | Full card | Added top-right shield indicator when guardrails enabled + shield stat in the stats row. | | `/src/components/ProfileCard.vue` | Modify | Mini card | Added shield quick-indicator when guardrails enabled. | | `/src/components/profiles/ProfileViewer.vue` | Modify | Header + detail | Added shield status badge next to the profile name and a Guardrails detail panel (scope, keywords, allowed tools). | **Design notes:** The shield uses `text-info` when guardrails apply and `text-base-content/30` when they don't (color + tooltip, never color alone). All new controls are DaisyUI components matching the existing dark-first system; the enable toggle mirrors the "Expose in API" toggle pattern already in the Settings tab.
